Generate Color Palettes

Source: R/15-color-palette.R
color_palette.Rd

This function generates color palettes for use in data visualization.

Usage

color_palette(palette_number)

Arguments

palette_number

An integer specifying the palette number between 2 and 9.

Value

A list of color palettes. The selected palette is returned based on the specified palette_number.

Examples

# Generate a color palette with 5 colors
my_palette <- color_palette(5)

# Display the first color palette
my_palette[[1]]
#> [1] "#2C3E50" "#E74C3C" "#ECF0F1" "#3498DB" "#2980B9"

# Display the second color palette
my_palette[[2]]
#> [1] "#E67E22" "#F1C40F" "#F3FFE2" "#ACF0F2" "#1695A3" "#225378"
